system_design.name: System Design
focus: Geographic placement & multi-region vs regional topology
Compute selection (Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions)
Storage selection & lifecycle policies
Networking & VPC design
Database design (Spanner, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Firestore)

operational_excellence.name: Operational Excellence
focus: CloudOps readiness & CI/CD deployment automation
Service Level Objectives (SLOs) & Error Budget policies
Structured Cloud Logging & Cloud Monitoring
Incident management, alerts & automated health checks

security.name: Security, Privacy, and Compliance
focus: Zero-trust network architecture (IAP, VPC Service Controls)
IAM least-privilege & Workload Identity Federation
Secret Manager & Cloud KMS encryption key management
Data protection & encryption at rest/in-transit
Cloud Armor perimeter defense & DDoS mitigation

reliability.name: Reliability
focus: High availability & zonal/regional redundancy
Idempotency & retry policies with exponential backoff
Graceful degradation, circuit breakers & rate limiting
Disaster recovery (DR), RTO/RPO targets & automated backups

cost_optimization.name: Cost Optimization
focus: Auto-scaling to zero on idle workloads
Managed serverless services vs IaaS overhead
Resource sizing, concurrency & memory tuning
Budgets, billing alerts & cost attribution tagging

performance.name: Performance Optimization
focus: Connection pooling & asynchronous execution
Low-latency caching (Memorystore Redis/Memcached)
Async event processing (Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Tasks)
Compute auto-scaling & Global HTTP(S) Load Balancing

sustainability.name: Sustainability
focus: Selecting low-carbon GCP regions (Carbon Free Energy %)
Efficient resource utilization & rightsizing
Minimizing idle compute and orphaned storage
